prompt: Create an original production-ready raster NINE-SLICE notification panel background for the premium Brazilian tropical board game Império Urbano. It will announce a pair of matching dice. Front view completely flat. Wide horizontal rectangular canvas, about 3:2. Entire rectangle fills the canvas edge to edge, no surrounding backdrop or padding. A beautiful compact champagne-gold beveled rounded frame, deep royal teal / emerald enamel rails, and a large calm pale ivory interior. Fine Brazilian tropical leaf flourishes and restrained gold starburst/sparkle engravings confined entirely to the four square corner blocks, each no larger than 24 percent of the short canvas dimension. Straight edge middles are simple clean smooth gold/teal rails that can extend in nine-slice rendering. Keep all major decorative motifs in the corners so they remain undistorted when the UI is resized to a small wide toast. Interior central 70 percent is nearly uniform warm ivory paper with a delicate pearlescent finish, fully empty for dark native UI text and live dice faces. Premium original handcrafted illustrated 3D cartoon materials, gold depth, cheerful elegant game craftsmanship without excessive confetti. IMPORTANT: do not draw any dice, numbers, pips, letters, words, buttons, coins, currency, crown, trophies or central emblem. No symbols that guarantee an extra turn, because the game message can differ. No watermark, no external drop shadow. All rounded corners fully inside the canvas. Opaque interior. Match the visual quality of a rich tropical Brazilian tabletop game rather than a flat mobile generic panel.
